# RichText add-on

A whole Markdown document rendered into **one** native text view - *selectable* and copyable as a single unit, including this `inline code` and a [link](https://example.com).

## Code

## Table

| Feature | Supported |
|---|---|
| GFM tables | yes |
| Table-aware copy | RTF / HTML / Markdown |
| Selection | whole document |
